title: Odd-degree majority coefficients
statement: For any nonnegative integers $m,j$, let $S$ be a set of coordinates in a cube of dimension $2m+1$ with $|S|=2j+1$. The Fourier coefficient of majority at $S$ is $(-1)^j\binom{m}{j}\big/\binom{2m}{2j}\;\cdot\;\binom{2m}{m}/2^{2m}$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $2m+1$ coordinates
